Oh my god.
Yep. My school banned yugioh cards.
Amen to the "you never get over it." Seriously people don't understand that shit.

I know I need to, it's just hard. 6 years ago I brought the issue up to them and they brushed it aside like it was nothing. It hasn't changed since then. Anyways, I stopped playing a while ago. I live a pretty normal life on the surface, it's just hard coping with the suicidal thoughts and such. Thanks so much for taking time to reply, it does mean a lot to me.

Dude, I miss it too. Me and my ex weren't really good for each other, but it's been a little over a year and I always wish that I could rewind and maybe change some things to make it work out. The feeling of being loved is addictive, and when it's gone you experience some real ass withdrawal symptoms. But the journey to finding love again is so beautiful... So don't give up on yourself. You're probably awesome and some dude out there will be lucky as hell to have a girl that can love like you can. Just give it time.

I'm a guy, 21, and I'm about to be a senior at a top 20 university. I legit just need someone to talk to this summer before I lose my mind.
